bayts.text: Through the Furqān (the Qur'an) I dwell in the neighbourhood of my Lord, the Helper; I have gained full mastery over my soul and driven far away the Accursed (Satan).
I have taken from this world of His only my provision for the Gardens of Paradise; passion has submitted to me, and the purity of my heart is complete.
The Righteous (Al-Abrār) will be my allies in my Hereafter, and the gifts of my hospitality will flow to me without end.
The letter "Jīm" accompanied me to the Gardens, while the Stoned One (Satan) was driven far from me, towards others.
My shield against the Accursed and the wicked is that the Incomparable Originator of the worlds is my Neighbour.
The Incomparable Originator honoured me with the Book and preserved me from whatever brings reproach.
Nothing will reach me, until my entering Paradise, except the glad tidings of the Most High, the Lord of Bounty.
No rebuke will touch me, nor any threat, and my whole life until the Gardens will be a feast ("ʿĪd").
God has kept hidden for me the Well-Guarded Secret (As-Sirr al-Masūn), out of love and by "There is no god but God" (Lā ilāha illā Allāh).
God guided me — and He is indeed the Incomparable Originator — and led me to Him through all kinds of wonders.
The Creator freed me from all besides Him, and He led me — He whose like is not seen.
The Book of my Lord was mine and I was its; through it, and for God, I have found dwelling and rest.
My shield against afflictions and corruptions is my safety from whatever brings corruption.
God honoured me with His Remembrance and with what He chose for me, and He led for me the most upright way.
God boasted of me before the radiant Noble Ones, and by my remaining He gladdened the Prophet.
The gifts of the Lord of Majesty and Generosity have made eternal for me what the noble aspire to.
God led to me what had never been, and what will never be for any contingent being.
I never doubt, at any moment, my being the neighbour of the Originator — what a wonder for the whole of creation!
Truly, what I have obtained from God is hidden from creation, and in it I have triumphed.
God Himself guided me to God, without any delusion, and accepted my whole life.
My enemies have been disappointed, together with the envious, since I received my price without any loss or depreciation.
The Everlasting (Al-Bāqī) preserved me through it from ruin; my trade with Him will never perish.
What would take me away from God will never touch me, by His grace and by "There is no god but God".
My reward is led to me without end by Him who has always been for me, and who purified my time for me.
I have dwelt beside my Lord through the language of the Arabs, without end, and my acts of nearness to Him have become sweet.
He drew out and kept for me Islam during my exile, among the islands — He who illuminates my earth.
The light of the language and of the Book was drawn out for me during the times of my service among the People of the Book.
The appendix of what was established for the Intercessor made my right hand free of need of harm or of cannon.
God guided me and drove the Accursed far away, to other than my life — how excellent a Helper!
